svg.title: PicoMondo system architecture
svg.text: One board that takes exhibit power, protects itself, and gives the RP2350B's GPIO robust connectors.
5 A PTC fuse, TVS, trips near 28 V
W25Q128, copied from the Pi reference
APS6404L on the second chip select
38 GPIO, 100 Ω in series on every pin
40 white LEDs, one per GPIO, ~1 mA
I2C sensors, shared with the INA226
Data buffered to 5 V, fused 5 V supply
